bus.via: Shanghai South Bus Station to Hangzhou

trips.route_note: High-speed trains from Shanghai Hongqiao reach Hangzhou East in about an hour, then metro or taxi to West Lake.
trips.why: The train beats the bus by about an hour and drops you at Hangzhou East with metro links to West Lake.
know: West Lake is free and best explored early morning
Book high-speed train seats in advance for weekends
Allow a full day to do West Lake and nearby sights justice

trips.route_note: High-speed trains run frequently from Shanghai Hongqiao or Shanghai Station to Suzhou in well under an hour, with the main sights reachable by local metro or taxi from Suzhou station.
trips.why: High-speed trains take only 35 minutes and the sights are easy to reach from Suzhou station.
know: Book train tickets ahead, especially on weekends and holidays
The classical gardens are the main draw and can be crowded midday
Spring and autumn are the most comfortable seasons

bus.via: Suzhou North Square to Zhouzhuang Water Village

trips.route_note: Direct tourist buses run from Shanghai to Zhouzhuang in about 1.5 hours; alternatively train to Kunshan plus a local bus or taxi.
trips.tour_query: Zhouzhuang water town day trip from Shanghai
trips.why: Direct tourist buses reach the water town in about 1.5 hours, while train plus local transfer is slower.
know: Water towns are most atmospheric on weekdays when quieter
Wear comfortable shoes for the stone lanes and bridges
Canals and old residences are the highlights
